newsitem.title: USA: Iomega in pact wth NEC, cuts Zzip drive pric.
newsitem.headline: Iomega in pact wth NEC, cuts Zzip drive pric.

text.p: Iomega Corp on Monday said it has agreed with NEC Corp to negotiate and sign a license to grant NEC non-exclusive global rights to produce and market drives utilizing Iomega's Zip technology.
While non-binding, the letter allows NEC to begin its marketing activities in anticipation of a definitive license agreement, Iomega said.
Iomega also said that it has cut the minimum advertised U.S. price of its Zip drive from $199 to $149. Zip drives and 100 megabyte Zip disks provide 70 times the capacity of traditional floppy disks.
